body.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production 2D cutout torso sprite for an existing chibi desktop pet. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target: a small headless, armless torso and red scarf registered in the lower center of a transparent 900x687 canvas. Image 2 is CLOTHING DESIGN reference only, not proportions or painting style. Image 3 shows the existing cute clean anime pet for STYLE reference only. Redesign ONLY the clothing appearance of image 1. Replace the fitted zip-up dark jacket with a relaxed loose black/charcoal medieval cloth tunic/tabard, subtle broad fabric folds, small ivory/off-white side panels near hem and neckline, restrained dark leather edging, matching reference 2's black-and-white cloth outfit. Keep a large vivid red folded triangular neckerchief/scarf EXACTLY in its original position and size, including the open shallow curved collar along its top. Eliminate zipper, center zip hardware and tailored waist seams. Do not add legs, belt weapons, head, hair, skin, hands, sleeves, shoulders outside the original silhouette, props, background, letters or labels. Exact invariants: retain image 1's tiny chibi torso proportions, total width and height, neckline shape, shoulder socket locations and hem silhouette, framing, registration and amount of empty transparent space; do not enlarge, recenter or crop the torso. Match image 3's smooth clean black anime outlines, soft cel shading, white/gray/black fabric and saturated red scarf; no low-poly facets or realistic painterly rendering. This is a texture replacement inside the same silhouette, not a character redesign in adult proportions. Actual transparent alpha background, no checkerboard illustration.

arms.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: 2D chibi desktop-pet arm sprite atlas with TWO isolated complete arms on transparent background. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target. Its left half contains one downward-pointing arm with a gloved hand; its right half contains the mirrored partner. Image 2 is a clothing reference ONLY. Image 3 is the newly redesigned matching torso, use its smooth anime outline and black/ivory cloth shading, not its shape. Redesign ONLY the clothing appearance of BOTH arms in image 1: replace the large shiny silver shoulder and forearm armor plates with soft loose ivory/off-white fabric sleeves, broad simple fabric folds, small charcoal shoulder yokes/trim and dark fitted cuffs; the lower wrists have black leather bracers with one subtle strap, and the hands remain small charcoal/black gloves, with the SAME cute rounded five-finger shapes, thumbs and downward spread pose as image 1. More cloth than armor, inspired by image 2's loose white sleeves and black gauntlets. No red on arms needed: the separate torso already has a red neckerchief. Exact invariants: keep the TWO arms, left/right order, same overall atlas layout, same vertical orientation, same shoulder centers, same hand/fingertip positions, same hand-to-arm proportion, same width, length, silhouette and total size. Keep the original finger contours very close: no lengthening, no adult proportions, no bare skin, no extra fingers. Do not make a T-pose person: only the two isolated arm cutouts. Arms remain disconnected from each other with clear empty space in the middle, not touching canvas borders. Retain image 1's clean chibi black ink outlines, smooth cel shading and rounded volumes. NOT realistic, NOT low-poly, NOT painterly. Genuine transparent alpha background; no text, no labels, no checkerboard illustration, no head, torso, sword or other objects.
